title: NUTRI FIT Digital Food Scale, 11lb Kitchen Scale Digital Weight, Cooking Scale for Food Ounces and Grams, 4 Units with 0.1oz/1g Precision, LCD Display with Tare Function
description:
About this item
Weigh up to 5kg/11lbs in increment to 0.1oz /1g for the Kitchen Food Scale. The Digital food scale is designed and crafted with quality in mind using the highest precision sensors to ensure accurate instant weight readings every single time.
Large weighing panel allows you to read result even with large container. The baking scale is equipped with 4 units of measure; easily convert between grams,ounces, milliliters, kilograms, pounds and ounces (lb:oz, g, ml, fl:oz)
Stylish Hanging Design: The sleek design allows you to accent your home kitchen with a modern fashion touch and amazing sight, or effortlessly hang the scale stow as a decoration, Its slim design also makes it easy to store in any cabinet while saving space for the rest of your kitchen essentials.
Multi- Function: features a clear LCD display, low power, overload indication and auto-off function after 3 minute of inactivity make weighing your foods Hassle-Free. It will help to save the power while you are not going to use it.
Package Included 1 x digital kitchen scale, 2 x AAA batteries, 1 x user manual and lifetime support.
reviews_5s:
If you are looking for a compact scale that has multiply purposes, this is the one!
While it's made from lot of plastic, its compact and measures correctly!
I purchased it for three reasons-
a) I was given a sour dough starter and you must weigh everything when feeding it and/or baking with it. Most recipes require measuring cups or spoons, but for sour dough starters, you measure grams. Anyone knows a handed down sour dough starter is extra special so you want to do it right!
b) I have a luggage scale, but there are times when I'm packing and I want to weigh a small item to see how much of it will impact the 50 pound suit case weight limit. I would rather have a ball park before carefully nestling everything into it's place in the packing process, zipping up the bag only to lift it with the luggage scale and find that it is 8 pounds over! Quick check on my nifty little scale for small items and I can ballpark the max of 50 pounds much better now!
c) ETSY! I have a shop and every time I've posted something to sell, it requires a trip to the post office to weigh the item in order to calculate the shipping cost, I now can now weigh my items at home and post my item online at etsy.com/shop/TLCBYGIGI so much quicker! This saves TIME for me. and time is something you can't buy more of!How do I describe this product, well this product is a must use in my kitchen. The weight accuracy is phenomenal, it is easy to use, easy to clean, accurate and a decent size.Does what it is supposed to do. Lightweight, easy to clean. Use it every day.Accurate and perfect for my routine kitchen measurements. Very slim and storage is easy. The control buttons operate with only feather light touch.Arrived on time, works as expected. Easy to useClick to play video
Super light weight. Small tack holds it to your cabinet side in the kitchen. Easy on-off switch. Accurate weighting system.
Place a plate on the scale, turn it on, and it calibrates to zero so anything you put in that plate is weighed. Easy cleaning wipe-off surface. Thin, so it can be stored very easily. I’d recommend this scale to everyone. Great price as well.thanksHelpful when measuring for bakingThe **NUTRI FIT Digital Food Scale** is a great addition to any kitchen, offering precision and ease of use for cooking and meal prep. With a maximum capacity of 11lb, this scale can handle a wide range of ingredients, from small portions to larger quantities. It provides measurements in four units: ounces, grams, pounds, and kilograms, with a precision of 0.1oz/1g, ensuring accurate readings every time. The LCD display is clear and easy to read, and the tare function allows for easy measurement of ingredients by subtracting the weight of containers or bowls. Whether you're baking, cooking, or tracking nutrition, this scale is a reliable and efficient tool for your kitchen.EXCELLENT product....!
reviews_1s:
I have weighed so many different things with this scale and have never gotten an accurate measurement. I have tarred it out, taken out the batteries and everything else I can think of but when I measured 8oz of cheese and it said 7lbs I knew it wasn’t fixable.I tried using this scale for very small measurements like 1 gram but it would always jump to 2 or 5 grams. I contacted the seller and they knew that it doesn’t measure a gram but still stated that it did in the description.Worked well till a week ago. Not turning on . Changed batteries & still nothing.I needed to get down to small weights. Unfortunately, the scale worked for a few weeks, but now can't hold a zero tare. When you weight something, the values are fairly different, and when you remove the weight, it doesn't go back to zero. I saw -6g often. Piece of junk.This scale is very inaccurate and displays lower weights than the actual item weighs repeatedlyDon’t waste your money !
This scale isn’t working and Amazon customer service are doing nothing for !Usually, I'm very lucky person with Amazone purchases (don't jinx), and I even have 6 dol item which is working for couple of years. And this time, I decided not to pay attention to some bad reviews and low price. But I'm in the shock how bad this device. It worked 5 times, then started to glitch. I even tried to switch cheap batteries to new Duracell. But it still showed "8888" error. For reference, I had before another scales which worked for 1 year without issues.
